segments.text: Compressed gas cylinders, proper handling and storage.
segments.zh: 压缩气瓶的正确搬运与储存。

segments.text: Before storing, handling or using compressed gas cylinders, complete Laboratory Safety Compressed Gas Cylinder training through Workday Learning.
segments.zh: 在储存、搬运或使用压缩气瓶之前，请通过 Workday Learning 完成实验室安全压缩气瓶培训。

segments.text: A compressed gas cylinder is a gas or mixture of gases contained under high pressure.
segments.zh: 压缩气瓶是在高压下盛装的一种气体或气体混合物。

segments.text: It is important to be aware of the hazards regarding compressed gas cylinders.
segments.zh: 了解压缩气瓶的相关危害非常重要。

segments.text: Cylinders can come in different shapes and sizes with removable or built-in caps.
segments.zh: 气瓶有不同的形状和规格，配有可拆卸或内置的瓶帽。

segments.text: Familiarize yourself with the safety data sheets for the gas prior to storing and handling.
segments.zh: 在储存和搬运之前，请先熟悉该气体的安全数据表。

segments.text: Make sure you understand the hazards as well as the chemical and physical properties of the material.
segments.zh: 确保你了解该物质的危害以及化学和物理性质。

segments.text: Accidents can occur due to improper storage, unexpected release or leaks, incorrect installation, damage to the cylinder and improper handling.
segments.zh: 储存不当、意外释放或泄漏、安装错误、气瓶损坏以及搬运不当都可能导致事故。

segments.text: Follow these compressed gas cylinder storage rules.
segments.zh: 请遵守以下压缩气瓶储存规定。

segments.text: Store in a cool, dry and well-ventilated space.
segments.zh: 储存在阴凉、干燥、通风良好的地方。

segments.text: Store flammable and oxidizing gases at least 20 feet apart unless an approved partition has been installed.
segments.zh: 易燃气体和氧化性气体的储存间距至少 20 英尺，除非已安装经批准的隔断。

segments.text: Store in an upright position, secured above the midpoint but below the shoulder with the safety cap secured.
segments.zh: 直立储存，在中点以上、瓶肩以下的位置固定，并拧好安全瓶帽。

segments.text: Never store gas cylinders in exits or egress routes.
segments.zh: 切勿将气瓶储存在出口或疏散通道中，

segments.text: In damp areas, exposed to direct sunlight or heat, near salts or corrosives, next to incompatible materials for longer than one year without use.
segments.zh: 也不要储存在潮湿区域、阳光直射或受热处、盐类或腐蚀性物质附近、不相容物质旁边，或超过一年不使用。

segments.text: When working in a lab, wear the minimum required PPE, eye protection, lab coat, gloves and fully enclosed shoes.
segments.zh: 在实验室工作时，请穿戴最低要求的个人防护装备：眼部防护、实验服、手套和全包裹的鞋。

segments.text: Before transporting the cylinder, confirm the cap is on and tightened.
segments.zh: 搬运气瓶之前，确认瓶帽已装上并拧紧。

segments.text: This cap protects the cylinder's valve in the event of a bump or fall.
segments.zh: 在气瓶受到碰撞或倒下时，这个瓶帽可以保护气瓶阀。

segments.text: Never lift a cylinder from the cap or drag a cylinder across the floor.
segments.zh: 切勿抓着瓶帽提起气瓶，也不要在地面上拖拽气瓶。

segments.text: Do not hand roll cylinders for more than a few feet. They are hard to control and dropping the cylinder is very dangerous.
segments.zh: 用手滚动气瓶不要超过几英尺。气瓶很难控制，一旦掉落非常危险。

segments.text: Do not try to catch a cylinder if it is falling. Many injuries are caused by trying to catch heavy objects.
segments.zh: 如果气瓶正在倒下，不要试图去接住它。很多伤害都是因为试图接住重物造成的。

segments.text: Transport the cylinder by securing it to an appropriate cart.
segments.zh: 搬运气瓶时，应将其固定在合适的手推车上。

segments.text: Only transport cylinders secured in an upright position and in university vehicles.
segments.zh: 只能在气瓶直立固定的情况下、使用学校车辆运输气瓶。

segments.text: Do not transport cylinders in passenger compartments.
segments.zh: 不要在乘客车厢内运输气瓶。

segments.text: Use an elevator or a dumbwaiter to move cylinders between floors.
segments.zh: 在楼层之间移动气瓶时，使用电梯或货梯。

segments.text: But do not ride with it.
segments.zh: 但不要与气瓶同乘。

segments.text: Attach a sign to the cylinder, telling others not to use the elevator during the cylinder's trip.
segments.zh: 在气瓶上挂一个标志，告知他人在气瓶运送期间不要使用电梯。

segments.text: For more information about gas cylinders, check out the Gas Cylinder Safety Guidelines Manual linked below.
segments.zh: 有关气瓶的更多信息，请查看下方链接的《气瓶安全指南手册》。

segments.text: If you have questions, please contact ISUEHNS.
segments.zh: 如有疑问，请联系 ISU EH&S。
